pages.title: Happy St. Patrick's Day with a Shamrock Border Coloring Page
pages.description: The St. Patrick's Day greeting fills this printable coloring page in three rows of bold bubble letters, with six three-leaf shamrocks framing the words.

pages.title: Easy Three-Leaf Shamrock with a Curved Stem Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a three-leaf shamrock with heart-shaped leaves and a long curved stem, drawn in bold lines that leave broad areas for coloring.

pages.title: Simple Four-Leaf Clover with Heart-Shaped Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: Four heart-shaped leaves meet at the center of this printable coloring page, forming a lucky clover with a curved stem and four open coloring spaces.

pages.title: Easy Leprechaun Waving Hello Coloring Page
pages.description: A leprechaun raises one hand in greeting on this printable coloring page, wearing a buckled hat with a shamrock and striped socks above his shoes.

pages.title: Smiling Leprechaun Face with a Curly Beard Coloring Page
pages.description: This close-up printable coloring page shows a smiling leprechaun with a curly beard and a bow tie beneath a tall hat decorated with a shamrock.

pages.title: Leprechaun Hat with a Buckle and Shamrock Coloring Page
pages.description: A tall leprechaun hat is the focus of this printable coloring page, with a wide brim, a rectangular buckle, and a shamrock tucked into the band.

pages.title: Simple Pot of Gold with Oversized Coins Coloring Page
pages.description: A round cauldron holds five oversized coins on this printable coloring page, with a loop handle on each side and three short feet beneath the pot.

pages.title: Rainbow Ending in a Pot of Gold Coloring Page
pages.description: A rainbow arcs from a rounded cloud to a pot of gold on this printable coloring page, with seven bands and a pile of overlapping coins.

pages.title: Leprechaun Counting Coins Beside His Pot of Gold Coloring Page
pages.description: A leprechaun sits cross-legged on this printable coloring page, holding one coin above a stack in his hand beside a round pot brimming with gold.

pages.title: Leprechaun Holding Up a Giant Shamrock Coloring Page
pages.description: A leprechaun grips the stem of a giant shamrock in this printable coloring page, wearing a buckled hat, striped stockings, and curled shoes.

pages.title: Leprechaun Dancing an Irish Jig Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, a leprechaun dances an Irish jig with one boot lifted, striped stockings, and a shamrock tucked into his hat.

pages.title: Leprechaun Playing a Fiddle on a Tree Stump Coloring Page
pages.description: Seated on a tree stump, a leprechaun draws a bow across his fiddle in this printable coloring page, with buckled boots and striped stockings.

pages.title: Girl Leprechaun Tipping Her Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a girl leprechaun tipping the brim of her buckled hat with one hand while her other hand rests in a pocket.

pages.title: Leprechaun Trap with a Ladder and a Trail of Coins Coloring Page
pages.description: A ladder leans against an open box decorated with shamrocks, and a trail of coins leads to the leprechaun trap in this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Cute Shamrock with a Smiling Face Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling shamrock fills this printable coloring page, with three heart-shaped leaves, a long curved stem, and broad open spaces inside the bold outline.

pages.title: Shamrock Wreath with a Ribbon Bow Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, a ring of overlapping shamrocks forms a wreath with an open center and a ribbon bow tied at the bottom.

pages.title: Lucky Horseshoe with a Shamrock and Ribbon Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page pairs a lucky horseshoe with six round nail holes, a three-leaf shamrock, and a ribbon bow with forked ends.

pages.title: Gold Coin Stamped with a Four-Leaf Clover Coloring Page
pages.description: A four-leaf clover sits inside the raised rim of a gold coin in this printable coloring page, with short lines marking the coin's ridged edge.

pages.title: Luck of the Irish Banner with Lucky Charms Coloring Page
pages.description: The words "Luck of the Irish" curve across a banner in this printable coloring page, with a horseshoe above and two shamrock coins below.

pages.title: Irish Flag Waving Above a Patch of Shamrocks Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, the Irish flag ripples in three broad vertical bands above a grassy patch where three shamrocks grow on curved stems.

pages.title: Irish Harp with Carved Celtic Knots Coloring Page
pages.description: Celtic knots run along the Irish harp’s upright pillar on this printable coloring page, beside a sweeping frame and a row of fine strings.

pages.title: Saint Patrick Holding a Shamrock and a Staff Coloring Page
pages.description: Saint Patrick raises a three-leaf shamrock on this printable coloring page while gripping a curled staff, with outlined crosses decorating his miter and robe.

pages.title: Celtic Cross with Woven Knotwork Coloring Page
pages.description: Interlaced ribbons fill the broad shaft of a Celtic cross on this printable coloring page, while a double-lined ring sits behind its flared arms.

pages.title: Shamrock Mandala with Interlocking Celtic Knots Coloring Page
pages.description: Five shamrocks surround a woven Celtic knot on this printable coloring page, with curved bands linking the motifs inside the mandala’s double-ring border.

pages.title: St. Patrick's Day Gnome Holding a Shamrock Coloring Page
pages.description: A bearded gnome wraps both hands around a shamrock stem on this printable coloring page, with a pointed buckled hat and rounded boots.

pages.title: St. Patrick's Day Puppy in a Leprechaun Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: A floppy-eared puppy sits with its tail curled on this printable coloring page, wearing a buckled leprechaun hat with a shamrock tucked in the band.

pages.title: St. Patrick's Day Cat Peeking Out of a Pot of Gold Coloring Page
pages.description: A cat peeks out of a pot of gold on this printable coloring page, with both paws on the rim and a bow tie above the coins.

pages.title: St. Patrick's Day Bear Hugging a Four-Leaf Clover Coloring Page
pages.description: A seated bear hugs a four-leaf clover on this printable coloring page, wearing a buckled hat and showing the round pads on its feet.
